Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes The PR distinguishes nested task completions consumed by a running subagent from completions forwarded after that subagent finishes. **Example:** Background agent outer-2 finishes before its nested agent inner-2. - **Before:** The outer reported result can finish the turn before inner-2 returns its final answer. - **After:** The outer reported result remains interim until inner-2 produces the final answer. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | Focused, useful repair with native transport evidence and both routing orders covered; the previous integration blocker is resolved. | | **Proof confidence** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | Sufficient (live_output): Retained contributor evidence exercises executeClaudeCli with real Claude Code 2.1.310 and a scripted local Messages API, covering both notification routes, terminal delivery and warm reuse; the integrated regression covers both orders and foreground retirement without claiming live Gateway or Anthropic-service validation. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** A nested background agent’s answer can be omitted when its launching subagent finishes first. **Reason:** The native routing distinction establishes a concrete delivery defect beyond the merged hang repair, with no new configuration or public contract. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep this PR open: it preserves forwarded nested-agent answers that current main can settle too early, and resolves the previous integration concern without an actionable correctness finding; exact-head CI remains pending. **Priority:** P1 **Reviewed head:** `7cc32e2454f848dac9b365e58281e2241d91c2f3` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None.
Agent review details ### How this fits together The Anthropic CLI adapter consumes Claude Code task events and uses task ownership and completion receipts to emit interim or terminal results to OpenClaw’s reply runner. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Admitted input] --> B[Claude Code process] B --> C[Native task events] C --> D[Task ownership and descendants] D --> E[Result settlement] E --> F[OpenClaw reply runner] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Retain this lifetime-aware repair so forwarded child answers complete before settlement while surviving foreground descendants still retire with their process. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main ownership and settlement code establish the premature-final path, supported by the reported failing base regressions and retained native traces; this read-only review ran no reproduction. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The patch is the smallest complete repair found: reuse the descendant tracker for launcher identity and distinguish consumed completions from forwarded continuations without changing watchdogs or permission policy. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [2499f2be3e88](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2499f2be3e88e025735268fb622e569d69fcd369). ### Provenance checked - `Nested task ownership` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (f36f0cc6fca969f191f2e9ce2d01ebb5efab7308: Exclude nested tasks because their completions can be consumed by the launching subagent.) - `Stopped-task and admitted-input settlement` keeps the original intent (a9479eb77d0e5cfb0686862b96720ea9e858cbe9: Release stopped work while preserving genuine current-input continuations and isolating earlier-input results.) - `Descendant tracking and process retirement` keeps the original intent (3eeb12bea80b482a8068d1cf27870a5e12be5bda: Retire processes with surviving descendants so they cannot inherit a later turn’s authority.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Current main still excludes forwarded nested work:** Current main assigns false ownership to every task carrying parent_task_id, so the launcher-finishes-first case cannot retain its child continuation. ([`extensions/anthropic/cli-runtime-tasks.ts:49`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/2499f2be3e88e025735268fb622e569d69fcd369/extensions/anthropic/cli-runtime-tasks.ts#L49), [2499f2be3e88](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2499f2be3e88e025735268fb622e569d69fcd369)) - **Previous integration concern resolved:** The introduced diff retains nested Agent and Workflow input ownership, records launcher identities in the existing descendant tracker, and releases a nested hold when its launcher remains running. ([`extensions/anthropic/cli-runtime-tasks.ts:48`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/7cc32e2454f848dac9b365e58281e2241d91c2f3/extensions/anthropic/cli-runtime-tasks.ts#L48), [7cc32e2454f8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7cc32e2454f848dac9b365e58281e2241d91c2f3)) - **Both completion orders covered:** The revised Agent and Workflow regression checks final delivery when the launcher consumes its child’s result, interim delivery when the launcher finishes first, and subsequent reuse of the same process; the body reports base failures and candidate passes. ([`extensions/anthropic/cli-runtime.task-ownership.test.ts:158`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/7cc32e2454f848dac9b365e58281e2241d91c2f3/extensions/anthropic/cli-runtime.task-ownership.test.ts#L158), [7cc32e2454f8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7cc32e2454f848dac9b365e58281e2241d91c2f3)) - **Foreground descendant isolation preserved:** The existing retirement rule still closes a process with surviving descendants, while the new pending-task predicate excludes children of unheld foreground work. ([`extensions/anthropic/cli.runtime.ts:383`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/7cc32e2454f848dac9b365e58281e2241d91c2f3/extensions/anthropic/cli.runtime.ts#L383), [7cc32e2454f8](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/7cc32e2454f848dac9b365e58281e2241d91c2f3)) - **Merged repair does not supersede this PR:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182267 merged the unconditional nested-task exclusion and closed https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/182175; its stated scenario addresses child-first completion rather than the forwarded-answer case retained here. ([`extensions/anthropic/cli-runtime-tasks.ts:49`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f36f0cc6fca969f191f2e9ce2d01ebb5efab7308/extensions/anthropic/cli-runtime-tasks.ts#L49), [f36f0cc6fca9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f36f0cc6fca969f191f2e9ce2d01ebb5efab7308)) - **Retained native behavior evidence:** The current body records real Claude Code 2.1.310 through executeClaudeCli with a local Messages API, both notification routes, terminal delivery and warm reuse; the earlier review at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/182516#issuecomment-6383209952 records inspection of those captures. This review reused that evidence and ran no target code. ([c427f9afac9c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c427f9afac9ccc98e46ff4545d96db786477977e)) Likely related people: - **cassthebandit:** Raw commit a9479eb77d0e5cfb0686862b96720ea9e858cbe9 adds extensions/anthropic/cli-runtime-tasks.ts:45 relative to its recorded parents. ### Review metrics | Metric | Value | Why it matters | |---|---|---| | **Production versus test growth** | Production +21 lines; tests +14 lines | The modest growth records launcher identity in existing state and extends the existing regression to cover both routing orders. | ### Labels Label changes: - add `rating: 🐚 platinum hermit`: Overall readiness is 🐚 platinum hermit; proof is 🐚 platinum hermit and patch quality is 🐚 platinum hermit. - add `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`: ClawSweeper has no concrete contributor-facing blocker left for this PR. - remove `rating: 🦐 gold shrimp`: Current PR rating is `rating: 🐚 platinum hermit`, so this older rating label is no longer current. - remove `merge-risk: 🚨 message-delivery`: Current PR review selected no merge-risk labels. - remove `status: ⏳ waiting on author`: Current PR status label is `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`. Label justifications: - `P1`: The affected Claude CLI workflow can settle before delivering a nested agent’s forwarded answer. - `rating: 🐚 platinum hermit`: Overall readiness is 🐚 platinum hermit; proof is 🐚 platinum hermit and patch quality is 🐚 platinum hermit. - `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`: ClawSweeper has no concrete contributor-facing blocker left for this PR. - `proof: sufficient`: Contributor real behavior proof is sufficient. ### Rating scale 6/6 🦀 challenger crab · 5/6 🦞 diamond lobster · 4/6 🐚 platinum hermit · 3/6 🦐 gold shrimp · 2/6 🦪 silver shellfish · 1/6 🧂 unranked krab.
